no tumor marker has been established as an independent prognostic parameter in head and neck cancer.

none of the markers examined in squamous carcinomas of the upper aerodigestive tract has shown a significant clinical effectiveness and prognositic value.

the search for new tumor markers is not over.
tumor markers in squamous carcinomas of the upper aerodigestive tract have not yet been able to provide additional information to the conventional tumor staging systems.

the use of tumor markers in the management of squamous cell carcinoma is not established and should be used with caution.
tumor markers in squamous head and neck cancer have limited clinical value and are not recommended for routine use.
